purpose: Test whether routing the existing variable-token Mamba branch into the AutoCon representation improves the same train-only ACF forecaster.
evidence_boundary: This is a paired exploratory validation-only architecture screen: H96, three seeds per dataset, eight epochs, and no test metrics are produced or used for selection. It is not confirmatory evidence.
research_question: With the same variable-token MambaACF AutoCon model, raw train-only ACF sidecar, relation target, sampler, and normalization, does variable-token representation fusion improve validation behavior over the identical forecast-only variable branch?
claim_boundary: Only paired descriptive deltas, relation-gradient diagnostics, and resource proxies may be reported. No universal accuracy, speed, or publication claim is allowed.

required_before_launch: human review of the one-factor variable-representation design
confirm train-only ACF sidecar identity and dataset fingerprints
run matched resource and CUDA shape/backward smoke for both arms
confirm relation telemetry records contrastive-active anchors rather than only positive-pair coverage
freeze this JSON, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root

phases.name: variable_repr_fusion_off_raw_h96
phases.purpose: Control arm: raw train-only ACF relation pipeline with the variable-token forecast branch enabled but representation fusion disabled.

phases.name: variable_repr_fusion_on_raw_h96
phases.purpose: Treatment arm: identical raw-source pipeline with variable-token states fused into the AutoCon representation.

planned_contrasts: variable-token representation fusion on minus off under the identical raw-source AutoCon relation pipeline
comparison_contract.relation_interpretation: Positive-pair coverage alone is insufficient. Report the fraction of anchors with both a target and an in-range denominator negative; a zero contrastive-active fraction means the magnitude contrastive term is degenerate and cannot support a representation-learning claim.
comparison_contract.resource_boundary: Adapter MAC/activation fields are analytic proxies; measured latency requires identical hardware, batch, warmup, synchronization, and evaluation settings.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Exploratory architecture evidence only; report sidecar identity, relation-gradient coverage, parameter/MAC proxies, and paired validation deltas before any mechanism claim.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation and dry-run expansion are the only permitted actions for this draft.
Invalidate a phase if any coordinate is missing or duplicated, any manifest record is not ok, provenance drifts, or the train-only ACF sidecar identity is not exact.
Select no arm using test metrics; a favorable screen is descriptive and requires a separately reviewed frozen replication.
